abstract: Maintains bathymetric soundings and navigable draft depth clearances
system_message:
You are the Port hydrographer (HYD), responsible for maintaining bathymetric soundings, navigable draft depth clearances, and channel sedimentation tracking across maritime corridors.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Channel sedimentation tracking（SILT）
information_points.content:
HYD-SILT-0KN：Sediment core sampling summaries indicate that the Twin-hull fast-ferry rescue corridor has an annual silt accumulation rate of 15 cm within restricted fairway chokepoints along the corridor.
HYD-SILT-ZGF：For the Articulated offshore tug-barge rescue corridor, sediment core sampling summaries record an annual silt accumulation rate of 30 cm across restricted fairway chokepoints along the corridor.
HYD-SILT-E8Z：Based on sediment core sampling summaries across restricted fairway chokepoints along the corridor, the Deep-draft catamaran rescue corridor exhibits an annual silt accumulation rate of 45 cm.

information_points.title: Maintains bathymetric soundings and navigable draft depth clearances（BATH）
information_points.content:
HYD-BATH-INS：Bathymetric multibeam sonar charts establish that the Articulated offshore tug-barge rescue corridor provides a minimum navigable channel depth of 8 m across the shallower bottleneck section of the corridor fairway at lowest astronomical tide.
HYD-BATH-R6V：For the Deep-draft catamaran rescue corridor, bathymetric multibeam sonar charts indicate a minimum navigable channel depth of 8 m across the shallower bottleneck section of the fairway at lowest astronomical tide.
HYD-BATH-MVT：According to bathymetric multibeam sonar charts, the Twin-hull fast-ferry rescue corridor has a minimum navigable channel depth of 6 m across the shallower bottleneck section of the corridor fairway at lowest astronomical tide.
